_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Woyɛ Odwumayɛni {player_id} wɔ Tic Tac Toe.
W'abɔdwuma ne sɛ wɔnyɛ nkɔɔto mmiɛnsa wɔ nkrataa no so (wɔnkyɛn, akyirikyɛn, anaa ɔkɔɔto mu).
Wɔ wo dwumadie, wuhwɛ kɔɔto kɔɔto (0-8) a wopɛ sɛ wɔde w'akyerɛ no asi.
Sɛ nhwɛso, '[4]' de w'akyerɛ no asi board no finimfin.
Sɛ Odwumayɛni {player_id}, wobɛyɛ '{symbol}', bere a w'abɔnefa no yɛ '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nsakrae a wɔde mae no nni ɔfã pɔtee bi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} nyɛ ɔdan a edi mu. Ɛwɔ sɛ ɛwɔ 0 ne 8 ntam.

game_action.placed: ɔkɔtɔni {player_id} de ne ho hyɛɛ ({symbol}) wɔ sɛl {cell}.
